title: ¿Dónde está el museo?
subtitle: Asking for directions
scene: You’re downtown with a map that isn’t helping. A woman is waiting at the corner.

lines.en: Excuse me, ma’am. Where is the museum?

lines.es: No, está cerca. Siga derecho dos cuadras.
lines.en: No, it’s close. Go straight for two blocks.
lines.note: Siga derecho = keep going straight. Una cuadra = one block.

lines.es: Derecho dos cuadras, y a la izquierda.

culture.title: Asking the way
culture.text: People are kind with directions, and some will answer even when they aren’t sure. If it matters, ask a second person. Distances are usually given in cuadras.

lines.es: De nada, joven. Que le vaya bien.
lines.en: You’re welcome, young man. Take care.
